# Updown.io

updown.io is a simple and inexpensive website monitoring service that checks the availability and performance of your websites and APIs.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/updown-io/.

## Actions

- **List IPv6 nodes** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all updown.io server ipv6 addresses.
- **List Monitoring Nodes** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all updown.io monitoring servers.
- **List Node IPs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all updown.io server ip addresses.
- **List node IPv4 addresses** (read-only): List all updown.io server ipv4 addresses.
